notes: K1: the three 5V seller claims led to purchases but no strip was ever powered; marked false because the log's world truth says the rated strips would light, not because a test confirmed it. K2: counted once per item per shop; a shop that had the item but fewer units than the quantity asked (El Gammal 2 vs 40+, El Tamimi 4 and no restock, Lampatronics 1 vs up to 50, New Maadi grocery 20 bottles vs 40-80) counted as true; the El Tamimi and grocery cases are judgement calls. Market-wide walking searches (log 162, 517) were counted as one ask each. Service asks (test places, storage) were left out. K3: counted per shop, so Most is counted once (call#5) though asked again in call#14; unanswered or unconnected asks were left out of K3 (they are in K7). K4: only Metanoia's three-day technician time, never acted on and not yet due; online listing delivery estimates (Jumia 5 days, Noon 4 days, Makers 4 days) were not counted because they were not promises made to the team and were not acted on. K6: the Manial-to-Carrefour actual (47) counts the 7 minutes of entrance confusion while still aboard (road leg 40); the Downtown-to-Manial quote (27) was the app's re-price after Abdelrahman's silent detour, seen only in the log; the final Hadayek October ride arrives after the log ends, so unclear. K7: the Metanoia reply counted as a firm no on the Sunday service that Seb could act on. K9: chat#154 is borderline; Seb said the photo did not show the label but did not ask for anything, so it is false. Seb-side calls were not counted as worker asks in K2.
